method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Global stocks power to record highs as deal ignites ‘risk on’ rally
Equities.summary: Investor sentiment also helped by SpaceX’s historic initial public offering
Equities.reason: Broad, market-wide piece capturing the dominant regime shift — Iran peace deal + SpaceX IPO = clear risk-on impulse and record-highs across global equities. High relevance as it signals a cross-market shift in sentiment and positioning; scored as a strong bullish equity narrative.

Equities.title: Wall St. futures advance over 1% as markets cheer Iran deal
Equities.reason: Timely market-movement headline showing US futures reacting strongly to the Iran ceasefire — reinforces the immediate risk-on flow into equities. High relevance for near-term price action and positioning.

Equities.title: Asia hedge funds notch triple-digit gains in AI-led rally
Equities.reason: Represents the leadership theme within equities (AI-led gains) that is underpinning the rally and driving concentrated flows. High relevance because it signals persistent sector leadership and P&L drivers beyond the geopolitical catalyst.

Equities.title: Stocks Climb, Oil Retreats on Iran Peace Deal: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market-wrap linking lower oil/energy-risk to broader equity gains — supports the dominant risk-on narrative and the macro channel (lower energy premium -> positive for cyclicals and broad indices). Moderate-high relevance.

Equities.title: SpaceX IPO sticks the landing. Here's what investors are saying about its epic first trading day
Equities.summary: Despite a large retail allocation and huge volume, volatility was moderate
Equities.reason: High-profile IPO success acts as a focal point for risk appetite, IPO pipeline and flow dynamics that are lifting broader equity sentiment. Relevant as a leadership/flow catalyst but narrower than macro deal headlines.

Rates.title: Treasuries Rally as Traders Trim Fed Hike Bets After Iran Deal
Rates.reason: Article describes a US Treasury rally tied to traders scaling back Fed hike expectations after an Iran deal; this implies lower yields (positive for bond prices). High relevance given US Treasuries' central role in global rates and policy-trajectory signaling.

Rates.title: Traders Cut South Africa Rate-Hike Bets After Iran Peace Deal
Rates.reason: Market pricing in fewer South African rate hikes implies easing pressure on SA bond yields (yields down). Relevant as an EM rates repricing tied to a geopolitical risk de-escalation that feeds into global rates sentiment.

Rates.title: Bond Funds Chase Australian Debt on Peak RBA Interest Rate Bets
Rates.reason: Flows into Australian paper tied to markets pricing a peak in RBA rates point to downward pressure on Australian yields. Moderately high relevance because it reflects cross-border flows and duration demand dynamics.

Rates.title: Global Funds Retreat From Japan’s Long Bonds as BOJ Goes Slow
Rates.reason: Outflows from long JGBs as BOJ lags tightening would push JGB yields higher (negative for bond prices). Significant relevance given the size of Japan’s bond market and implication for global yield curves and portfolio flows.

Rates.title: Bailey Defends BOE Gilt Sales After Criticism From Farage
Rates.reason: BOE gilt sales (and defence of that policy) imply supply-side pressure on gilts and potential upward pressure on UK yields. Relevant to UK rates but more policy/PR than a large instantaneous market shock, so moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Japan’s Top Bond-Trading Regional Bank Buys JGBs After Decade
Rates.reason: A notable domestic buyer returning to JGBs supports demand and thus lower yields locally (positive for JGBs). Lower relevance because it is idiosyncratic and partly offsets broader outflow narrative.

FX.reason: DXY-specific piece pointing to USD weakness after a major geopolitical de‑escalation. High FX relevance and market-wide USD transmission supports a high positive score (non‑USD currencies stronger).

FX.reason: Direct EUR/USD move tied to the US‑Iran peace news; reinforces the broader USD‑weak / risk‑on narrative, giving the euro material FX relevance.

FX.reason: Bank research explicitly links the ceasefire to USD downside and broader FX flows; supports the dominant USD‑weak / risk‑on narrative with solid market‑level relevance.

FX.reason: Representative counter‑signal: BBH highlights near‑term USD support from Fed dynamics despite risk‑on; included with lower relevance to reflect an important but minority theme versus the peace‑driven USD weakness.

FX.title: Yen Short Bets Jump to Nine-Year High as Carry Trade Revives
FX.reason: Market‑structure signal: rising yen short positioning indicates renewed carry and potential JPY weakness even amid risk events — high FX relevance for USD/JPY and G10 flows.

FX.title: Swiss Franc edges higher on US–Iran peace deal
FX.summary: The USD/CHF pair slumps to near 0.7930, the lowest since June 5, during the early European trading hours on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Swiss Franc (CHF) after the US and Iran announced a framework deal for peace.
FX.reason: CHF strength vs USD tied to risk‑on/peace narrative; direct FX move with moderate relevance given CHF's safe‑haven/countercyclical role.

FX.reason: AUD/USD pickup driven by improved risk sentiment after the geopolitical development; clear FX transmission (commodity/risk currency) with reasonable relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD soars to near $70.80 as US-Iran reach peace deal
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up 4% to near $70.80 in the Asian trading session on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Peace deal fuels risk-on positioning and industrial-demand optimism, which tends to lift industrial metals including silver (and can overpower safe-haven dynamics). The move is market-relevant and immediate, so medium-high relevance assigned.

Commodities.title: London Gold Market Weighs Earlier Auction to Suit Asian Traders
Commodities.reason: Market-structure change (earlier auction) is a modest positive structural signal for liquidity and Asian demand for physical gold. The item is relevant to gold market mechanics but is not a standalone price driver, so low-to-moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Singapore to Begin Gold Clearing This Year in Push to Become Hub
Commodities.reason: Singapore introducing gold clearing is a material structural development that can deepen Asian physical market liquidity and potentially support regional demand for gold. This is a constructive, medium-term bullish structural narrative for the metal.

Commodities.title: Copper Pops Higher as US-Iran Agreement Puts Bulls in Charge
Commodities.reason: Copper is an industrial metal that benefits from risk-on and resolution of geopolitical uncertainty. The peace deal is a clear positive for demand/sentiment in industrial metals, and the headline indicates an immediate market reaction — high relevance and positive direction for copper.

Commodities.title: UK forces board sanctioned Russian shadow fleet oil tanker
Commodities.summary: The U.K.'s Ministry of Defence says the SMYRTOS was in the English Channel and will be held off the south coast during investigations.
Commodities.reason: Enforcement action against an oil tanker tied to a sanctioned 'shadow fleet' raises near-term supply/disruption risk in oil shipping and can support crude and refined product prices. It's a regional security/shipping story with moderate relevance to oil.

Commodities.reason: Rising RIN prices increase compliance costs for refiners and tend to support domestic gasoline/diesel prices (RBOB/diesel). This is a direct fuel-market transmission and therefore relevant to the commodities (refined products) complex.

Crypto.reason: SEC movement toward a tokenization regulatory path is a structural positive for institutional adoption of tokenized assets, even if not a comprehensive rule yet. Crypto.reason: Rapid growth in tokenized treasury volumes is direct evidence of institutional adoption and on‑chain liquidity for cash‑like assets. This represents a big structural flow into crypto rails from traditional finance — strongly positive and highly relevant for the asset class.

Crypto.reason: Executive view tying tokenization to the ETF adoption playbook underscores the narrative that tokenized products could unlock large institutional pools. Conveys medium‑high structural upside for crypto adoption and products.

Crypto.reason: Development of perpetual futures as scalable institutional wrappers would deepen liquidity and broaden access — positive for market structure. Relevance moderate as product evolution can drive flows but is less immediately concrete than on‑chain tokenization volumes.

Crypto.reason: Significant institutional rotation into XRP ETFs indicates product‑level flow divergence inside crypto — positive for broader institutionalization but signals redistribution away from BTC/ETH. Moderate relevance as it highlights shifting allocation dynamics within the asset class.

Crypto.reason: Geopolitical easing (US‑Iran deal) removed an oil/geopolitical risk premium and coincided with BTC strength — a near‑term positive risk‑on/flight‑to‑risk impulse for crypto. Market‑moving but tactical in nature, so relevance is moderate.

Crypto.reason: Security and hack risk directly threaten custodial trust, institutional onboarding and on‑chain liquidity. A credible escalation in exploit sophistication is a material negative for crypto adoption and risk premia.

Crypto.reason: Reports that Wall Street is progressing from pilots to meaningful Ethereum engagement point to increased institutional product integration and real asset‑backed use cases on chain — structurally positive for ETH and ecosystem activity.

Crypto.reason: Narrative that stablecoins are sitting idle suggests weaker transactional demand and lower velocity, which undermines one of crypto's key plumbing advantages. Negative for trading volumes and DeFi activity; relevance below hard regulatory/product headlines.

Crypto.reason: Broad regulatory wave ('summer of regs') is a mixed but net tightening force; uncertainty and enforcement risk weigh on sentiment and institutional timing. Treated as a modest net negative for near‑term flows and product launches.

Crypto.title: Here's what SpaceX's IPO means for its $1.3 billion bitcoin reserve
Crypto.reason: Corporate reserve holdings and potential selling linked to an IPO represent a modest supply overhang risk for BTC. Impact is relevant but idiosyncratic and limited in scope compared with systemic adoption drivers.

Crypto.reason: Product innovation targeting AI payments is a small positive for on‑chain payments and XRPL’s use cases, but current market inertia (USDC dominance) limits immediate impact — low‑to‑moderate relevance.
